title: 360° Video and Photos on a Boat Trip in Madeira: What You Get
description: Every private boat trip from Funchal includes Insta360 360° video, drone footage and real camera photos. Here is what you get and how to film the best shots.
heroAlt: Madeira's dramatic green sea cliffs seen from the Atlantic

images.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of Madeira's towering green and dark basalt sea cliffs near Cabo Girão rising from the deep blue Atlantic, seen from the water in clear late-morning light, a small white private motorboat far below the cliff.
images.alt: Madeira's sea cliffs rising from the Atlantic with a small white boat below

images.prompt: Photograph of a small white private motorboat anchored in a calm turquoise cove at Fajã dos Padres, Madeira, with a person mid-jump into the clear water and the cliff behind, bright midday sun.
images.alt: A guest jumping into the turquoise water beside a small white boat

images.prompt: Photograph of a small white private motorboat sailing along the Madeira south coast at golden hour, seen from above like a drone shot, with the cliffs and Câmara de Lobos village glowing in warm light.
images.alt: A small white boat on the Madeira coast at golden hour seen from above
